ops.text: Plan-mode plan-file Write guard misfired for two Plan subagents in one session: Write refused with "already written" for a plan file that did not exist, and Edit could not create the missing file — both agents had to return their plans inline instead of writing the designated plan path. Repro context: subagents of a plan-mode session, each told to write to the session plan file; the guard appears to treat the parent's plan-file state as already-written for children.
